name: Dholavira: a Harappan City
description: Dholavira is a 5,000-year-old Harappan city on the dry island of Khadir in Gujarat, western India. Its stone-walled citadel, streets and houses rise above the surrounding flats. Residents survived in this harsh land by channelling water from two seasonal streams into reservoirs. Visitors can also see a large cemetery with six types of cenotaph.
